clips.send: Karst (喀斯特 kāsītè, also 岩溶 “rock-dissolving”) is land made of rock that water can dissolve, mostly limestone. The name comes from the Kras region of Slovenia. Southwest China has one of the biggest karst areas on Earth.

clips.send: There are sea-creature fossils on top of the world’s highest mountain. Stone pillars in Zhangjiajie are taller than skyscrapers, and hills in Zhangye are striped like a rainbow. Nobody built them: water, wind, ice and the slow push of the Earth carved them over millions of years. How?

clips.send: Rain soaks up carbon dioxide from the air and soil and becomes a very weak acid (carbonic acid — the fizz in soda). It reacts with limestone (calcium carbonate) and carries it away, grain by grain. Hot, rainy places dissolve fastest.
clips.text: Rain soaks up carbon dioxide from the air and soil and becomes a very weak acid (carbonic acid — the fizz in soda). It reacts with limestone (calcium carbonate) and carries it away, grain by grain. Hot, rainy places dissolve fastest.

clips.send: In caves like Reed Flute Cave (芦笛岩) in Guilin, water full of dissolved limestone drips from the ceiling. As each drop loses its carbon dioxide, a tiny ring of calcite is left behind: stalactites (石钟乳) grow down, stalagmites (石笋) grow up, and when they meet they make a column (石柱). Set the growth rate and press to fast-forward time.

clips.send: Zhangjiajie’s pillars are quartz sandstone, which hardly dissolves at all. Water, frost and gravity broke the rock apart along vertical cracks (joints) after it was lifted up — mechanical carving, not chemical dissolving.

clips.send: Each layer of sandstone and mudstone was laid down at a different time with different minerals — mostly iron in different forms. Rusty iron oxide gives reds and browns; other minerals give yellow, white and grey-green. Uplift tilted the layers and erosion exposed the stripes.

clips.send: 世界最高峰的山顶上，竟然有海洋生物的化石。张家界的石柱比摩天大楼还高，张掖的山坡像彩虹一样一道一道。没有人建造它们——是流水、风、冰川和地壳运动，用了几百万年甚至上亿年“雕刻”出来的。怎么做到的？
clips.text: 世界最高峰的山顶上，竟然有海洋生物的化石。张家界的石柱比摩天大楼还高，张掖的山坡像彩虹一样一道一道。没有人建造它们——是流水、风、冰川和地壳运动，用了几百万年甚至上亿年“雕刻”出来的。怎么做到的？

clips.send: 在桂林芦笛岩这样的溶洞里，溶有碳酸钙的水从洞顶滴下。水滴中的二氧化碳逸出后，碳酸钙沉淀：洞顶向下长出石钟乳，洞底向上长出石笋，二者连在一起就成了石柱。拨动生长速度，按 让时间飞逝。
